DECLARATION OF ZONING,DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTRESTRICTIONS THIS DECLARATION OF ZONING,DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT RESTRICTIONS (this “Declaration), made as of the — day of June, 2007, by SOCHIN DOWNTOWN REALTY, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 485 Broadway, 5th Floor, New York, NY 10013(Declarant). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Declarant is the fee owner of certain lands,with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 19 in Block 233 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,County of New York (the*Tax Map) and as and by the street address 150 Lafayette Street, New York, New York (the*Lafayette Street Parcel),and Lot 2 in Block 233 on the Tax Map (the“Crosby Street Parcel), all of the foregoing as more particularly described in Exhibit “A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (collectively, the*Land', either of Lafayette Street or Crosby Street may be referred to as aParcel); WHEREAS, Declarant intends to (i) demolish the building currently existing on the Crosby Street Parcel, (i) demolish a portion of and add additional floors to the building currently existing on the LafayetteStreetParcel and to construct other improvements associated with such additional floors (the existing building on the Lafayette Street Parcel and such additional floors, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements, repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Declaration, are herein collectively referred to as theLafayette Street Building', and (ii) construct a portion of the Lafayette Street Building on the Crosby Street Parcel below curb level, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) (the"Crosby Building); WHEREAS, Declarant desires to provide for the amount of floor area (as hereinafter defined) that may be utilized and developed on each Parcel, without regard to the amountoffloorareathatwouldotherwisebeavailabletoeachsuchParcelifeachParcelwere considered a separate zoning lot (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS the Land comprises a single zoning lot pursuant to Section 12-10(c) of the definition of zoning lot in the Zoning Resolution and Declarant has executed a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions to confirm the existence of the Land as a single zoning lot comprising the Lafayette Street parcel and the Crosby Street Parcel (the Land, as same may hereafter be enlarged, may hereinafter be referred to as the*Merged Zoning Lot); and WHEREAS, Declarant desires to set forth certain provisions with respect to the rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters. 2 KL3 2595699.1
